resolution.note: Measured stages over PRs 253-285 (scripts/ci-stage-time.mjs); ranked cuts in .krn/runs/lead/weakness-hunt/stage-time.md; shipped early bwrap start and Changes without setup-node.

title: Measure delivery time per stage and rank the cuts
body: Outcome: a committed, reproducible measurement of where delivery time goes, per stage, over the last 15 merged PRs: `krn/gate` stages (from Jenkins), `krn slice run` stages (from `.krn/runs/slice/*/journal.json` and landing logs), review panel duration, `pnpm install` in the worktree stage, and lead wait time; then a ranked list of cuts with an estimated saving each (sharding tests across executors, a dependency DAG instead of a serial gate, a pnpm store/cache for worktrees, skipping unchanged stages). Reference: t3code release.yml runs 8 server-test shards of ~2 min in parallel behind one preflight. Proof: a script under scripts/ that prints the per-stage table from real records, and a test that runs it on a verbatim capture.
